extraction_notes: Main-text NH3 synthesis performance figures digitised from Figure 1. Figure 1b and 1c Arrhenius insets were skipped as Arrhenius plots. Figures 2, 3a–c, 4, 5, and 6 are characterization/mechanistic/isotope/TPSR/DFT figures rather than plotted NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF for N2 + H2 synthesis. Figure 3d shows N2 isotope exchange, not ammonia synthesis, and was skipped. Figure 1a appears to include reference/comparison catalysts; the plotted bars were included because they are shown with the same reaction conditions and experimental error bars, but assignments are limited to the visible catalyst labels.
